|--------|----------|-----------|

| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Assessment

**System Health: ✅ Good**

- 198 iterations completed in ~21 hours
- No stuck/inconclusive candidates
- ~27 hours remaining in budget
- Champion stable with acceptable MDD

**Key Trade-offs:**
- Champion has stronger tuning performance
- Last PASS candidate shows better lockbox consistency (higher min)
- Champion maintains tighter drawdown control

## Recommended Actions

The queued commands are appropriate. On next session:

```bash
# Execute in order:
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items
- Monitor if tuning min on candidates can improve (0.051 is concerning)
- Fold14 MDD creeping toward -10% threshold
- Continue exploring candidates that balance lockbox consistency with tuning robustness
